verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party machine-payments docs page names x402 explicitly ('Stripe also supports stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol'). The same page gives operational detail, a 0.01 USDC minimum, so this is documented product support rather than a blog aspiration. Missing for 10: concrete x402 endpoint or SDK reference in the evidence, any mention of ACP, MPP or AP2, and independent or hands-on corroboration that x402 payments work.
